findings.summary: The draft omits TARGET_BEFORE_F, INFEASIBLE_AT_D95, NOT_RUN and PRUNED_OR_UNREACHED handling, so executed-stage membership and the R07 denominator can differ from the authoritative join policy.
Raw log presence is indexed without validating wall time, exit status, ATPG status, timeout, failure retention, retry lineage, or environment cohort.
The v7 marker mapping does not reproduce the authoritative suffix-stripping basename normalization.
The draft does not retain enough per-action status to prove every formal action is covered or bind all preregistered methods to one identical frozen action space.
The registration receipt and immutable held-job fields are not verified, and bhist/bacct evidence is neither captured nor required by RELEASED_VERIFIED.
git show output is decoded and stripped before hashing, which changes trailing bytes and makes reviewed blob verification incorrect.
Release verification checks field shape but not PASS count equations, zero missing and ambiguity, unit coverage, or action-space invariants.

passed_checks: fixed command-line argument shape and basic LSF job-id refusal

required_disposition: Preserve v7 as failed draft evidence. Implement v8 by faithfully embedding the authoritative recovery and mode-aware join semantics, byte-exact Git binding, complete held-job registration and scheduler-history verification, and full release invariants.
